title: Build slab models
action: Construct the CuO chain-terminated YBa2Cu3O7 slab with two unit cells along z and a 2×2 supercell in-plane (lattice constant a=3.9419 Å), including a vacuum region. Also build the defective slab with a single oxygen vacancy at the surface CuO chain (configuration (a)).
description: Generate stoichiometric and single-vacancy slab geometries in PDB format for downstream DFT calculations.

title: O2 molecule reference calculation
action: Compute the total energy of an isolated O2 molecule using DFT with the same settings (PBE, ultrasoft pseudopotentials, wavefunction/charge density cutoffs 50/450 Ry) to derive the oxygen chemical potential mu_O = E(O2)/2.
description: Reference calculation to obtain the oxygen chemical potential needed in the vacancy formation energy formula.

title: Calculate oxygen vacancy formation energy
action: For each external electric field (0, 4, 6, 10, 30 V/nm), apply a sawtooth potential with dipole correction, relax the stoichiometric slab and the defective slab (configuration (a)), then compute the vacancy formation energy per vacancy using ΔE_vac = (E_vac - E_stoi + mu_O). Output formation_energies.csv with columns field_V_per_nm and delta_E_vac_eV.
description: CSV file with the formation energy of a single surface oxygen vacancy at five applied electric field strengths.

title: Extract bond lengths at 30 V/nm
action: From the optimized defective slab at 30 V/nm, measure the Cu-O_surface bond length and the O_plane-O_surface distance. Write bond_lengths.json with keys Cu_O_surface_A and O_plane_O_surface_A, both in Angstrom.
description: JSON object containing the two characteristic bond lengths from the relaxed geometry at the highest field.
